sourceDiagnosis.summary: SiteWipe 1.11.53 invoked a non-awaited armCleanupApproval message immediately before permissions.request(). Chrome granted the four exact reviewed patterns, but the worker never durably observed an armed approval before the popup lifetime ended. The worker correctly treated the permission event as wake-only and refused cleanup authority.
sourceDiagnosis.evidenceBoundary: This installed failure justifies the later two-activation source correction but does not convert that correction or a mock result into an installed-browser pass.

No private extension identifier, disposable-profile location, downloaded-file location, or other local filesystem path is included in this public evidence record.
